exponential backoff: four attempts, starting at one second and doubling, with
full jitter. Give up after the fourth attempt and surface the failure instead
of looping, because a client that retries forever turns one throttled endpoint
into an outage for every caller behind it.

records.body:
Retrying an OAuth refresh without jitter makes every throttled client wake up
at the same instant, so the second attempt is as throttled as the first. Use
full jitter on the exponential backoff for token refresh, keep the ceiling at
four attempts, and treat a 429 on the last attempt as a hard failure rather
than as a reason to extend the retry budget.

records.body:
Rebuild the whole search index under a fresh index name when the document
schema changes, and swap the search alias once the search index rebuild
finishes. Rebuilding the search index in place leaves the search index
unqueryable for the whole rebuild, and search recall drops silently.
